rationale: C05 plausibly supplied a material termination-proclamation template: it identifies the earlier proclamation and its enabling transaction, recites the statute's express authority to terminate that proclamation, and then declares termination as of a specified date. The child follows the same sequence for a copyright extension and uses closely parallel operative language. C10 is a similarly strong termination model but lacks the child's especially close statutory-authority recital. C02 shares the mechanism of changing a prior proclamation's effective period by a short new proclamation, but postponement is less analogous than termination.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas the said section 9 of title 17 of the United States Code authorizes the President to terminate any such proclamation at any time
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas the said section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended, authorizes the President to terminate any proclamation carrying out a trade agreement entered into under such section
shared_material.explanation: Both expressly recite statutory authority to terminate the earlier proclamation immediately before the operative clause.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the aforesaid [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of March 27, 1947, and the extension of time granted thereby, shall terminate on December 29, 1950
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do proclaim that the said proclamation dated May 4, 1935, is hereby terminated as of the close of December 31, 1949
shared_material.explanation: The operative provisions use the same concrete machinery: identify an earlier proclamation and terminate it on a specified date.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas, under the authority of the act of Congress ... I issued [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of March 27, 1947
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas, under the authority vested in him by section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930 ... the President ... entered into a trade agreement ... and proclaimed such trade agreement
shared_material.explanation: Each begins by tracing the prior proclamation to its statutory authority and underlying action before establishing the basis for termination.
